title: Create "file error codes" for use in wsutil
description:
To remove the dependency of wtap.h (and its error constants) in wsutil, create a list of the currently used ones (all file related) and return those from within wsutil.

Callers of the API either ignore the specific error (just looking for pass/fail) or call g_strerror on it (and WTAP_ error codes don't match up with them either)

Ping #20901

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
